component: background field (exterior + interior pedestal), everything that is not the frame stroke, arc cores or central flare

coordinate_convention.measurement_frame: pixel-index: integer coordinate = centre of that pixel, x right, y down, 0..1023
coordinate_convention.svg_user_space: SVG_user = pixel_index + 0.5 for a 1024 viewBox rendered at 1024 px. Every number in this file is in the PIXEL-INDEX frame unless the key says _svg.

frame_geometry_used.note: taken from out/analysis/frame.json (SVG units) minus 0.5; the equivalent circular corner radius 171.758 reproduces the measured stroke centre-line to 0.79 px rms / 1.86 px max, which is ample for masking

masks.interior: signed distance to the stroke centre-line SD < -8
masks.exterior: SD > +4.6 (i.e. clear of the 6.13 px stroke and its AA)
masks.glow_free_main: SD<-8 AND dist-to-nearest-arc-ridge AD>185 AND dist-to-flare FD>300  -> 159 178 px = 20.0% of the interior
masks.glow_free_strict: SD<-8 AND AD>240 AND FD>350 -> 80 593 px = 10.1% of the interior
masks.arc_ridges: the 2529 sub-pixel ridge points published in out/analysis/arc_geometry.json

recommended_interior_gradient.centre_uncertainty_px: +-25 px; the chi2 surface is shallow, moving the centre 25 px changes the G sd by <0.02

tilted_linear_5stop.note: linearGradient at 17.5 deg from vertical (direction vector (sin17.5, cos17.5) = (0.3007, 0.9537)); 5 evenly spaced stops over t in [95.9,1187.4] where t = 0.3007x + 0.9537y

flat_lower_envelope_base.note: the darkest coherent interior colour, measured in the two axial wedges; used as a base it over-predicts only 0.29% of interior pixels, so every other layer can be purely additive, but it under-predicts the glow-free field by a mean of 4.0 G / 4.6 B and therefore requires the arc-glow layer to supply a very broad pedestal

interior_dark_region.method: pixel noise = sqrt(mean within-2x2-block variance); 8x8 DC sd = sqrt(boundary_step_rms^2 - midblock_step_rms^2)/sqrt(2) using per-pixel steps across 8-aligned block edges vs mid-block controls

texture_and_noise.smudge_verdict: DO NOT reproduce. After the recommended radial gradient the residual over the glow-free interior has sd R 0.90 / G 1.08 / B 1.40 (strict mask). Of the G residual, 0.31 is pixel noise, 0.69 is 8x8 DCT DC blocking and about 0.64 is a smooth >=32 px "smudge" (32 px block-mean sd 0.664, range -2.1..+3.5 code values, autocorrelation 0.39 at 8 px, 0.12 at 16 px, 0.00 at 32 px). Reproducing the smudge perfectly would lower the interior-background G MAE from 0.86 to about 0.60 - i.e. 0.26 code values over 20% of the canvas, 0.05 code values of whole-image MAE. It is not reproducible with vector primitives, it has no symmetry, and it is exactly the signature of a resampled/recompressed source, so it is an artefact.

layer_order: 2. rounded-rect path (the frame stroke CENTRE-LINE path) filled with the radial gradient
3. (other agents) arc glows, arc cores, flare
4. the frame stroke itself, painted LAST so it hides the fill edge

svg_construction.clip_note: Fill the SAME path the stroke is drawn on, and draw the stroke afterwards. No <clipPath> is needed: the 6.135 px stroke straddles the path by +-3.07 px, so the fill edge (and its antialiasing) is completely hidden. If the lead prefers a clip, clipPath with that same path is equivalent.
svg_construction.boundary_measurement: Measured: immediately OUTSIDE the stroke the field is 0.7-1.1 R / 1.0-3.6 G / 1.4-5.7 B, i.e. at or slightly BELOW the far-field exterior (0.86/2.19/6.67), not at the interior level (2-3/6-11/12-19). A fill edge overhanging the stroke outer edge by even 0.5 px would lift the adjacent exterior pixel by about +2 G / +4 B; the observed sign is negative (JPEG undershoot). Immediately INSIDE the stroke the field is 8.3-9.2 G on the left, 11.3-11.4 G on top, 5.8-6.8 G on the bottom, 6.3-6.7 G on the right, with only a 2.4-2.8 code-value dip in the last 1.5 px (frame.json identifies that dip as ringing). So there is no inset gap either. CONCLUSION: the fill boundary lies somewhere in SD in [-4.5,+3.1] px of the stroke centre-line and cannot be localised better than that; painting it exactly on the centre-line is the safe choice and is indistinguishable from any other choice inside the stroke.
svg_construction.renderer_verification: The construction above was rendered with tools/render.py (both resvg and chromium at 1024 px) and compared with the continuous model: resvg reproduces it to MAE 0.21/0.31/0.34 (max 0.92) and chromium to 0.23/0.36/0.39 (max 1.42) - i.e. both interpolate gradient stops linearly in sRGB CODE space, so the stop colours above can be used as measured with no gamma correction. Against the reference over the glow-free main mask the rendered SVG gives MAE R 0.728 / G 0.978 / B 1.250 (resvg) and 0.747/1.002/1.267 (chromium); over the exterior MAE R 0.515 / G 0.597 / B 1.492.
